## Summary

Builds 3 new topic-cluster hubs — /pricing, /troubleshooting, /maintenance — each in EN/MS/ZH (9 new routes), modelled on the existing /installation hub.

Closes #66.

## What's included

### Core content (config/topic-hubs.ts)
- 3 hubs x 3 languages = 9 standalone page files
- Each hub: hero section, 4 curated group cards with real price badges, comparison table, authored editorial section with direct-answer H2+paragraph, full cluster-member index (derived from real blog/service/problem/tool configs — never stale), 5 FAQs with FAQPage schema, photo proof gallery, cross-hub linking strip, closing CTA, PageExplainers blocks

### Architecture
- **config/topic-hubs.ts** — Authored trilingual copy + group data + hub member slug lists (derived from real configs so slugs never rot)
- **components/topic-hub-page.tsx** — Server component hub renderer (hero, cards, table, editorial with direct answer, member index, photo proof, FAQs, cross-hub strip, CTA, explainers)
- **config/topic-hub-links.ts** — Lightweight client-safe registry for member-to-hub CTAs (BLOG_CATEGORY_HUB and SERVICE_HUB_MAP)
- **components/topic-hub-cta.tsx** — Reusable member-to-hub CTA strip

### Member-to-hub backlinks (two-way linking)
- Blog posts: via category matching (Pricing & Cost Guide to /pricing, Troubleshooting to /troubleshooting, Maintenance Guide/Chemical Services to /maintenance)
- Problem pages (EN/MS/ZH): to /troubleshooting
- Service pages (dynamic EN/MS/ZH + static maintenance-contract): via SERVICE_HUB_MAP
- Calculator pages: to /pricing (in ToolPageLayout)
- /aircond-service-price-malaysia (EN/MS/ZH): to /pricing
- /installation-price-malaysia (EN/MS/ZH): to /pricing

### Navigation and sitemap
- Navbar: /pricing added (EN: Pricing, MS: Harga, ZH: price label)
- Footer: Topic Hubs section with links to all 3 hubs
- Sitemap: all 9 routes added at priority 0.95 to 0.88
- PageExplainers presets: 3 new hub-specific presets
- Service gallery: 9 new photos (3 per hub) in config/service-gallery.ts

## Verification

- npm run typecheck: pass
- npm run lint: pass
- npm run build: pass (2175 sitemap URLs, 2181 prerendered pages)
- npm run verify:build: pass
- npm run audit:gsc: pass (only pre-existing kampung-install warning)
